'''Media Division''' was a branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. It managed all communications and content for public broadcast throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Media Division also handled all public relations throughout the Sector, and was responsible for the Sector's image in bordering [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. It was in charge of all advertising and subliminals, known as [[sub-vert]]s, as well as propaganda, consumer contests, demographic studies, and labor recruitment. Media was also tasked with producing entertainment programming for the [[holomedia]]. Subdivisions included [[Demographics]], [[Public Relations]], [[Entertainment]], [[Recruitment (Corporate Sector Authority)|Recruitment]], and [[Product Advertising]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
